verdict.rationale: Docs show the API exposes essentially all major Le Chat-style capabilities (agents, function calling, websearch, code interpreter, document RAG, image generation, audio, MCP, reasoning, structured outputs), indicating strong functional parity between API and UI. However, there is no explicit vendor statement guaranteeing full UI/API parity, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, so machine-readable API discoverability is incomplete. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, independent verification that every UI feature (e.g., Le Chat-specific UX features) is reachable via API, and a working OpenAPI/schema reference.
